mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 1 degrees now, light rain and snow. Next 24 hours: high 3, low -3.

Russia is confronting a new fuel shortage as repeated Ukrainian attacks have forced 15 oil refineries to halt operations, sharply reducing the country's fuel production capacity.

Germany will launch a new private pension scheme on 1 January 2027, allowing citizens to receive up to €540 a year in state support to supplement their retirement savings.

The Kosovo Prosecutor's Office ordered a halt to the installation of a Mother Teresa mural in Pristina, suspending work until a court decides on the case.

Opposition protesters gathered in Tirana's Skanderbeg Square, threw stones and Molotov cocktails, and clashed with police who used water cannons and tear gas, leaving at least one person injured.

More than 103,000 people in North Macedonia are working in the informal sector, remaining outside regular employment contracts despite a decline in overall informal activity.
